notes:
- SiriusXM: fixes sessions that dropped after sign-in, so channels start reliably.
- Pandora: tracks start more reliably and are skipped less often on slow connections.
- TuneIn: more stations play, because all current stream formats are now requested.
- TuneIn: if a station's first stream fails, its other streams are tried before giving up.
- TuneIn: when a station cannot be played, a message says so and the zone stops instead of staying silent.
- Windows XP: radio stations that stream over https now play, including stations on non-standard ports.
- Calm Radio: free accounts only list channels they can play.
- NuVo: fixes TuneIn Favorites and menu errors on NuVo panels.
- Media library sync no longer treats the server as new after every restart.
- Diagnostic logs sent from the Config page are now complete.
